name: Forlorn Cavern
summary: Tucked along the northern shores of Ironforge's subterranean lake, the Forlorn Cavern is a dimly lit, secluded district far removed from the city's bustling Great Forge. It serves as a shadowy refuge where thieves, cutpurses, and practitioners of the dark arts conduct their business away from prying dwarven guards.

sections.title: Ironforge's Shaded Corner
sections.body: While the rest of Ironforge clangs with anvil strikes and radiates heat from the Great Forge, the Forlorn Cavern is cold, damp, and hushed. Wrapping along the northern edge of the mountain's underground lake, the winding pathways sit comfortably out of sight between the Mystic Ward and the Hall of Explorers. Its gloom makes it an ideal gathering place for those who prefer to keep their affairs discreet. Local authorities largely turn a blind eye, leaving cutpurses to compare poisons, warlocks to consult grimoires behind closed doors, and quiet tradesfolk—like weapon smiths and lone fishermen—to ply their crafts undisturbed.

faq.q: Where is the Forlorn Cavern located in Ironforge?
aliases: how to get to forlorn cavern
faq.answer: The cavern sits in the northern portion of Ironforge along the subterranean lake. You can enter it by heading east out of the Mystic Ward or west along the tunnel from the Hall of Explorers.

faq.q: Why do rogues and warlocks gather here?
faq.answer: Ironforge's civil authorities and clergy take a dim view of both demonic pacts and organized pickpocketing. The cavern's secluded, poorly lit corners provide warlock cabals and the thieves' guild the discretion they need to train novices and trade illicit goods without provoking the mountain king's guards.

faq.q: What shops and services can be found in the Forlorn Cavern?
faq.answer: Aside from rogue and warlock trainers, the cavern features Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms catering to practitioners of dark magic, the Stoneblade weapon shop, and a quiet angling supply post known as The Traveling Fisherman.

angles.text: The cavern serves as the Alliance's primary rogue hub within Khaz Modan, offering poisons, specialized blades, and discreet trainers hidden along the damp stone walkways.
Dwarven society vehemently distrusts fel magic, forcing practitioners to gather inside Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms to bind demons and trade grimoires in secret.
